notes.text: The writer states that the institution participated for three years in a mode of financing he considered profoundly immoral and extremely dangerous; he announces departure on 30 Septembre prochain and suspension of scientific collaboration while such subsidies continue. notes.text: The typescript attributes to Monsieur L. Motchane agreement that from 1er Octobre 1970 the IHES would cease distributing the named mathematical texts. It states that Julius Springer will distribute the Séminaire in Lecture Notes, then thanks Springer and Monsieur K. Peters for assistance and typing.
